subject: Nutrition

questions.q: Which type of fiber is known to lower blood cholesterol levels?
questions.explain: Soluble fiber (found in oats, beans, fruits) binds bile acids in the gut, promoting their excretion and forcing the liver to use cholesterol to make more bile, thus lowering blood cholesterol.
